title: Smoke alarms in a NSW rental
description: A landlord's smoke alarm duties for a NSW rental. Summarised from NSW Fair Trading and Fire and Rescue NSW pages on the Residential Tenancies Regulation 2019.

sources.title: Smoke alarms in a rental property
Smoke alarms - what is the law?

items.title: At least one alarm on every level, in the hallway near the bedrooms
Check every alarm once a year
Replace removable batteries every year (lithium batteries as the manufacturer says)
Replace any alarm within 10 years of its manufacture date
Repair or replace a faulty alarm within 2 business days of finding out
Use a licensed electrician for hard-wired alarms
Give 2 business days' notice to inspect and 1 hour's notice to repair
Keep a record of each check and repair
